## WiFi Agent 1.2.0

This release focuses on reliable native installation, clearer first-run setup,
and accurate visual connection status.

### What’s new

- First launch now asks for portal credentials and completes the initial
  login-time setup before showing the dashboard.
- The Windows Settings page now scrolls in compact, non-maximized windows, so
  Test Connection and save/install actions are always accessible.
- The dashboard now recognizes the portal’s authenticated `LIVE` response. It
  remains visibly connected when the background session is valid even if a
  public connectivity probe is blocked or inconclusive.
- The macOS package now opens the installed application bundle reliably after
  installation.
- Windows and macOS builders now run the frozen application’s GUI/runtime
  self-test before creating an installer.
- Installers are attached individually to this release—no Actions artifact ZIP
  extraction is required.

### Downloads

- `WiFiAgent-1.2.0-Windows-x64-Setup.exe` — Windows 64-bit setup
- `WiFiAgent-1.2.0-macOS-arm64.pkg` / `.dmg` — Apple silicon Mac
- `WiFiAgent-1.2.0-macOS-x86_64.pkg` / `.dmg` — Intel Mac

### Validation

- 25 regression tests
- Ruff and Python compilation
- Shell and workflow syntax validation
- First-run and configured-dashboard Tk smoke tests
- Packaged-runtime self-test on each native CI runner

### Signing status

The repository does not currently have Apple Developer ID or Windows signing
certificates configured. Windows may display an unknown-publisher warning;
macOS may require **Open Anyway** in **System Settings → Privacy & Security**.
The application payload is still ad-hoc signed on macOS and runtime-tested
before packaging.
